name: Monitor Threshing
implementation_notes: threshing_record/threshing_detail local SQLite tables in localSchema.ts unchanged by this revision (same columns/unique constraint) -- only the row-population pattern changed

threshingRecordRepo.ts covers all 3 mobile Threshing screens (037/041/045) in one file, same convention as cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts covering screens 009/012/015; its full unit test coverage (threshingRecordRepo.spec.ts, 28 tests) is reported under this screen since it was authored first in sequence

REVISED 2026-08-24 (entity-catalog v12, correcting the original design the user explicitly rejected): createDraft() now inserts ONLY the header row -- the 24 pre-created threshing_detail rows were a literal reading of the paper log-sheet mockup that wasted screen space; rows are now added one at a time by the user in Form Threshing via 'Tambah baris', exactly mirroring cagesTrackRecordRepo.ts's cages_tipped_time pattern

'Jumlah Baris Time-Slot Tercatat' counter redefined as a plain COUNT(*) of threshing_detail rows belonging to today's records -- no longer filtered by 'has >=1 reading column filled', since row existence itself is now the meaningful signal (a row only exists because the user explicitly added it)
Router: route name 'monitor-threshing' registered in router/index.ts, but StationListView.vue (screen-006, explicitly out of this task's scope) has NOT been updated to link to it -- see known_issues

known_issues.description: StationListView.vue (screen-006, out of this 6-screen task's scope) has not been updated to add a Threshing tile/link to 'monitor-threshing' -- this screen is reachable directly by route/URL but not yet from the Station List grid. Needs a separate revision of screen-006.

Browser (Playwright) e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/monitor-threshing.spec.ts) was authored following the exact pattern of the other mobile station screens' e2e specs, but could not be executed in this sandboxed environment against a running dev server + seeded backend -- verified only by static review, not a live run.
